visible_segments_note: Approximate visible dialogue-state segments reviewed across the 59 physical IDs. Official contextual completion remains ID-based; one state-heavy ID still contributes at most one contextual ID. Use this estimate only for workload sizing/throughput interpretation, not ledger coverage.

incident.detail: A deliberately placeholder packet SHA was submitted because the local session could not reproduce the Git checkout required by build-beta1-review-packet.py. The workflow exposed actual SHA 42e123c4c4cf456c5d46276134ed3594ad35c4e5338c4172877f56bd2d347889; scope-019 was immediately sealed with that value and the final scope workflow passed. This is process overhead, not translation-review time.

classification_note: Batch 019 was intentionally state-heavy and source-order. Physical ID count is not a reliable proxy for visible dialogue workload. No class-specific stopwatch was instrumented, so rapid/ordinary/high-risk timing is intentionally omitted rather than inferred.
timing_note: Only workflow timestamps were independently observable. reading_seconds, evidence_seconds, and end-to-end wall_clock_seconds were not separately instrumented and remain null. ci_wait_seconds is the sum of the successful heavy-edit and dense-scope workflow elapsed windows. incident_seconds is recorded separately and must not be folded into normalized review throughput.
review_method: Sequential source-order dense full-read. Every selected ID was read Japanese meaning/context first, then pinned English treatment/reason, then Korean naturalness/accuracy. Scanner/AI signals were discovery-only; no propagation was credited.
